summary: Nexa Resources S.A. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports net revenues of $888.3 million, gross profit of $272.1 million, and net income attributable to shareholders of $89.3 million, with earnings per share of $0.67. No special-situation transaction—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring—is disclosed. This is a routine periodic earnings update for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. quarterly report. No action or event beyond normal financial reporting is indicated.
